# gtme secret

Store a credential in ~/.gtme/secrets (VALUE omitted = prompt, no echo)

## Forms

```
gtme secret set KEY [VALUE]
```

## Exit codes

| Code | Means |
|---|---|
| 0 | ok |
| 1 | other error |
| 2 | validation or contract error: the plan, the file, or a value was refused |
| 3 | auth or credential error |
| 4 | rate-limited by a vendor |
| 5 | network error |

## Example

From [Your CSV](/start/my-csv):

```sh
gtme secret set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
```
